items.coder_A: Gliosarcoma is named only as one example of eligible malignant brain tumours (mainly paediatric); conditions list only paediatric brain tumour.
items.reason: Inclusion criteria name gliosarcoma: 'recurrent or progressive malignant brain tumor including, but not limited to, infant-type hemispheric glioma, gliosarcoma'. C7 counts gliosarcoma named in inclusion criteria, so the trial passes S5.

note: Screening is unaffected: the only intervention is an NK cell therapy, so the trial fails S6 (excluded_intervention_type). Eligible types include non-glioma tumours (intracranial sarcoma, ependymoma), so basket_gbm_eligible is an arguable alternative; both are include categories.
